crossRefs.note: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
He needed to pass through Samaria.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
translations.bsb: While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, as they were on their way to Jerusalem, that he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
